target_statement: For each L>=1 and k>0, characterize universal suffix realization over all n with 10 ∤ n: whether there exists P,e such that 0<P, Canonical P e L, Palindrome P, and P % 10^k = n % 10^k. Candidate sufficient bound is 2*k <= L+1, including the odd-center overlap; investigate the converse as a separate universal-impossibility statement. The candidate is unproved and may be refuted or narrowed by exact counterexample.
